content:
Oasis assistant feature callout

Spotlight / pulse tour anchored to the navbar pill (replacing older “chat button” selectors) to teach first-time discovery.

What this is

A feature callout (ASRouter) can spotlight the Oasis toolbar pill with a short tour so new users discover how to open the assistant.

How to use it

  • Follow on-screen arrows; click Try steps when offered.
  • Dismiss politely if you already know the flow; tours may respect frequency caps.
  • Open the assistant from the pill if the tour hides the panel.

Notes and limits

Callouts require eligible channels and locales; some enterprise policies suppress them.
